comhad apt repository

Debian and Ubuntu packages for comhad, a ranger-style terminal browser for S3. amd64 and arm64, Debian 12 or newer and Ubuntu 22.04 or newer. 

sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
curl -fsSL https://eoin-mcmahon.github.io/comhad/comhad.gpg \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/comhad.gpg > /dev/null
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/comhad.gpg] https://eoin-mcmahon.github.io/comhad stable main" \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/comhad.list > /dev/null
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install comhad

Other install methods are listed in the README.
